{{Hatnote|For the 2002 European Continental Champion, see [[Marcin Solonczak]].}}
'''Marcin Sciesinski''' (handle '''MarcinS''', GitHub '''MarcinSc''') created [[GEMP]] in 2011.<ref name="t7301" /><ref name="ghname" /><ref name="historyvid" /> The first public implementation was for [[The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game]].<ref name="t7476" /> [[Troy Biesterfeld]] later forked Star Wars CCG from GEMP.<ref name="t52222" />
